{{Quote|Master Sifo-Dyas requested the most powerful army in the galaxy. We have worked with only the best shipbuilders to fulfill that request.|[[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]|<ref name="Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The '''''Acclamator''-class transgalactic military assault ship''', alternatively referred to as the '''''Acclamator''-class assault ship''' or '''''Acclamator''-class trans-galactic military transport ship''', or by the shorter names '''''Acclamator''-class transport''', '''''Acclamator''-class troopship''', or the rarer '''Acclamator I transport''', was an [[Assault ship/Legends|assault-class]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] created for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]]. It was the predecessor of the later Republic and Imperial models in the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] line.

==Characteristics==
===Dimensions===
[[File:Republic-Assault-Ship.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Cut-away of an ''Acclamator'', showing (from left to right): The hyperdrive, hypermatter reactor core, hangar area, fuel silos]]
The ''Acclamator''-class assault [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was 752 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, 460 meters in width, and 200 meters in height.<ref name="AOTC Cross-Sections" /> Its mission profile required it to both carry troops and engage enemy starships: the ''Acclamator'' was designed to assault contested systems, break hostile orbital blockades, and land troops directly on the battlefield. Consequently, the ''Acclamator'' favored a wedge or dagger shaped design due to its effectiveness—it allowed concentration of firepower while minimizing target profile. This basic design was used in a number of larger craft pre-dating it and would define Imperial ships for decades to come.<ref name="Warfare" />

The underside of the ''Acclamator'' was dominated by a large assault hangar capable of offloading an entire [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and their vehicles in short order.<ref name="Warfare" /> Most of the passenger and barrack decks were located on the upper levels of an ''Acclamator''-class ship.<ref name="AOTC Cross-Sections" />

The bridge was located in the middle of an arrow-shaped command tower module that protruded from the dorsal superstructure. This tower module was a standard design for smaller ships in [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards's]] starship catalog, which Rothana supplied vessels to. The main bridge and command center had no windows but relied upon advanced holoscreens<ref name="AOTC Cross-Sections" /> shaped like the triangular viewports similar to the ones on other Kuat vessels.<ref name="SW:RC">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref> The bridge crew usually consisted of fully-armored [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] manning the control panels,<ref name="Chapter 5">{{CW|5}}</ref> with most operators being seated in twin crew pits below the command officer's area.<ref name="SW:RC" /><ref name="SW:TCWvg">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> Sensor and communications suites were located at the front of the ship's command tower.<ref name="AOTC Cross-Sections" />

===Complement===
''Acclamator''-class ships had berths for sixteen thousand clone troopers, the equivalent of an entire [[Legion/Legends|legion]] or [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] and its support personnel. They also carried eighty aircraft and eighty-four armored vehicles, such as the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] and [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery|SPHA]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], used to provide clone troopers with heavy battlefield support.<ref name="Warfare" /> In addition to ground landings, ''Acclamator''-class ships were capable of water landings, as displayed at the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]].<ref name="Chapter 5" />

[[File:ImperialMarch-AOTC.png|thumb|right|300px|[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] march up a boarding ramp of an ''Acclamator'' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].]]
Each ''Acclamator''-class ship held 320 speeder bikes, used by clone troopers for fast battlefield reconnaissance and patrol duties. Eighty [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transports]], of which around 66 were [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|infantry gunships]] and around 14 were [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|vehicle carriers]], were carried to insert personnel, vehicles, and cargo into battle zones in addition to providing close air support. Gunships were suspended along an overhead circulating rail in the upper hangar for maintenance procedures during travels. A lower, smaller hangar area was used to embark and disembark ground troops and material via a large ramp when landed. The two levels were connected with elevator platforms.<ref name="AOTC Cross-Sections" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
Despite being largely transports for land forces, these ships were armed well enough to engage in planetary bombardment or ship to ship engagements. Armed with 4 heavy torpedo launch tubes; 24 [[Point-defense laser cannon/Legends|point-defense cannons]], rated at 6 megatons per shot; and 12 quad [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets, each rated at a maximum of 200 gigatons per shot. The hull armor of ''Acclamator''-class vessels was impregnated with ultra-dispersive [[Neutronium/Legends|neutronium]] that withstood and spread massive energy blasts. [[Fusion rocket]]s fired by enemy forces barely made a scratch on the hull as a result.<ref name="AOTC Cross-Sections" />

Groups of these ships could perform a "[[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]]," an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] that would exterminate all life on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="AOTC Cross-Sections" /> The later [[Acclamator II-class assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator II''-class]] could also serve as star frigates to support their landing groups.

===Propulsion systems===
The ''Acclamator''-class's main reactor was located in the middle of the vessel, inside the main superstructure, and was preceded at the frontal half of the ship by multiple fuel tanks. The tanks compressed [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] to enormous density for storage. The tanks were connected to the main reactor via pipe assemblies. Secondary reactors were located towards the bow of the vessel.<ref name="AOTC Cross-Sections" />

The ship's main thrusters were fitted with eight electromagnetic rudders that deflected the exhaust particle streams and gave boost when turning the ship. The secondary thrusters did not provide as much power, but were useful for maneuvering due to being placed further away from the ship's main axis. The massive fin at the stern of the ''Acclamator''-class contained both the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|anti-gravity]] generator and the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] generator. When landed, the repulsorlift carried much of the ship's weight, but the landing legs maintained a stable contact with the ground.<ref name="AOTC Cross-Sections" /> The massive hyperdrive generator took up some two hundred meters of the ship's length, and allowed a sustained [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] cruising speed of Class 0.6.<ref name="Warfare" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
The ''Acclamator''-class design was already in development by Rothana and Kuat [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the start of the Clone Wars, and the design was tested as early as [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Vehicle">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 35|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 35]]</ref> As the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived on Kamino to gather an invasion force, dozens of ''Acclamator''s had already been built and readied for the soldiers they were designed to carry.<ref name="Saga Edition" /> In their first engagement at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the class proved pivotal in the Republic victory, delivering legions of clone troopers to the battlefield<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> while a large Republic fleet engaged the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] fleet in orbit. After delivering their troops, the ''Acclamators'' pulled back to provide orbital support, with only a portion of the ships ending up damaged in the battle.<ref name="Saga Edition" />

[[File:Acclamator-TCWIV.png|thumb|left|300px|An Acclamator active during the war]]
Just after the battle had concluded, the Republic ordered 1,000 more ''Acclamator''s<ref name="Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook" /> based on their success as primary ground force delivery vehicles. All ''Acclamator''s were completely crewed by clones though they would also count regular Republic officers among their crews, as the war ground on. Apart from this, the ''Acclamator''s and larger warships were generally off-limits to most regular defense force personnel.<ref name="Saga Edition" /> During the height of the war, some ''Acclamator''s had the paint markings of the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]] like the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venators'']].<ref name="SW:TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

Several different variations were used during the war, with the ''Acclamator II''-class assault ship being the most numerous alternate model.<ref name="Saga Edition" /> The subclasses saw many battles in both the Clone Wars and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="MTS2">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/Mesop2|text=Message to Spacers 2}}</ref> Many were operated to act as mobile depot ships or dedicated [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] carriers. For the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], the assault ship ''[[Nevoota Bee/Legends|Nevoota Bee]]'' was modified as a [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]], with her hangar decks dedicated to holding 156 [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]].<ref name="Warfare" /> The [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class]] and other Star Destroyers were based on the Acclamator.<ref name="TNEGtVaV" />

===Later service===
[[File:Acclamator-side-landed.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Side-view of a landed ''Acclamator'']]
In addition to being a warship and a military transport serving forces in backwater areas,<ref name="Saga Edition" /> some [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ''Acclamator''s were used as [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] ships, transporting large quantities of enslaved people to various Imperial penal colonies during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire: In the Shadows of Their Fathers">''[[Star Wars: Empire: In the Shadows of Their Fathers]]''</ref> Although they were initially not considered "Star Destroyers", the ''Acclamator''-class was sometimes referred to as such during the reign of the Empire.<ref name="Empire at War" /> The Empire also modified a number of ''Acclamator''s, sacrificing weaponry to increase cargo capacity for use as [[Imperial cargo ship]]s. The Empire never used the Acclamator in its fleets but did use them in planetary defense or skirmishes.<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Some fell into the hands of criminal groups such as the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]].<ref name="FoC" /> The Empire continued to use them as of [[Operation Shadow Hand]],<ref name="DE">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' [[Star Wars: Dark Empire (trade paperback)|2003 cover]]</ref> and by [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], an Acclamator was located in the headquarters base of the [[Restored Empire]] splinter faction of the Empire.<ref name="Crimson" /> They were even used well into the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

At least one ''Acclamator'' was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which took part in the [[Disaster at Deepspace Besh|Battle at Tingel Deepspace Besh]].<ref name="Rebellion 4">[[Rebellion 4|''Rebellion'' 4]]</ref> 

One ''Acclamator I''-class assault ship was utilized by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] as part of her [[Maw Irregular Fleet]] during the [[Battle over Exodo II]] in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Acclamator-conceptart.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for the ''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]
The ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' mentions that the starships and vehicles used by the Republic during the Clone Wars, such as the ''Acclamator'' and AT-TE, were "retired" shortly after the end of the conflict. This is inconsistent with what is shown in the post-[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']] era, such as ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' and the ''[[Star Wars: Empire]]'' comic series, where they are shown to be in continued use, albeit on the Empire's more remote worlds. In the case of the ''Acclamator'', some are specifically mentioned as "slave ships" by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the [[Star Wars: Empire: In the Shadows of Their Fathers|''In the Shadows of Their Fathers'']] story arc. [[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'' (Saga Edition)]] clarified that ''Acclamator''s were used by forces in backwater areas.

In the game ''Star Wars: Empire at War'' and ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', the ''Acclamator''s present seem geared towards ship-combat rather than carrying ground forces, and are designated as [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]]. The [[2007]] edition of ''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]'' states a crew of 20,141 and a hyperdrive rating of 0.75 for both ''Acclamator'' classes, contradicting the respective numbers of 700 and 0.6 given by ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''. Incredible Cross-Sections states that the Acclamator's bridge was windowless; visuals are obtained via screens or holographic displays. However various comics and the Clone Wars series depict the vessel with Star Destroyer style trapezoidal window arrays.
